digest.component_or_area: reconciler, grounding, batch runner, code quality remediation
propositions: Environmental inheritance bug in reconcile_helpers._read_local_tickets and run_differs._read_local_ticket_full: when no_sync=False, _env is set to None causing subprocess to inherit parent REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off, silently suppressing live sync pull.
Dead-copy _HAVE_ASTGREP capability flag defined but never used in test_conformance.py and test_coverage_reconstruction.py must be removed, while retaining legitimate usage in test_engine_b.py.

BatchRunner.run signature requires alignment: ProductionBatchRunner accepts optional agent_runner parameter, but base BatchRunner, DefaultBatchRunner, and CodeReviewBatchRunner do not, causing mypy override-compatibility issues.

Tier-2 dead symbols verified unused and removed: _RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK, _PRIORITY_JIRA_TO_LOCAL, _TYPE_JIRA_TO_LOCAL, _SCRIPTS_DIR, _REFUTE_ELIGIBLE_KINDS, multiple test fixture constants, and nested _boom function.
Input-contract validation non-review category test (AI-3b) must be added to test_validation_depth.py to prove validation is category-agnostic.
